About Our College
Govt. Model Degree College, Baghbar
, was established in 2023 with the
                            vision of providing accessible and quality higher education to the youth of the greater
                            Baghbar region. Prior to the founding of this institution, students from Baghbar and its
                            surrounding areas faced significant challenges in pursuing higher studies...
